name: multipile
description: Multipile plugins for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: gitrepo
plugins.description: Work in a git repository that declares piles: subtrees with a .pile/ directory whose intent.md says why each is one thing. Skills that send the agent to pile, the multipile command line, at the right moment: before a change, before a commit, to review a pull request by pile, to write an intent, and to lay out or refine the piles.
